title: Fourier estimator from queried inputs
statement: Let $\mathcal{F}$ be a finite family of subsets of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$, let $m\in\mathbb{N}$, and supply $|\mathcal{F}|m$ inputs from the sign cube $\{-1,1\}^n$. The program queries the target at these inputs, arranges the resulting labeled inputs as a matrix indexed by $\mathcal{F}$ and $m$ samples, charges $|\mathcal{F}|m(n+1)$ local computation steps, and returns the finite-family Fourier estimator as a sparse Fourier hypothesis with rational coefficients.
caveat: The referenced matrix equivalence and estimator output function are not defined in the supplied definitions, so their precise construction cannot be rendered.
